quran_text_all_rows.arabic_uthmani: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍۢ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍۭ

butuncul_okuma_all_lines.raw_line: **106:0.** بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ — Birincil okuma: Rahmân ve Rahîm olan Allah'ın adıyla başlayan söz, bütün sûreyi ilahî adın altında konumlandırır. Sonraki ayetler bu merhameti soyut bir şefkatten çıkarıp evi, yolculuğu, rızkı ve güvenliği kuşatan fiilî bir bakım olarak gösterir; ad, mevsimsel hareketin üstünde koruyucu bir çatı gibi çalışır. {س م و B005; ء ل ه B002; ر ح م B001; ر ح م B002; ر ح م B003; ب ي ت B001; ط ع م B002; ء م ن B001}
butuncul_okuma_all_lines.reading_text_tr: Rahmân ve Rahîm olan Allah'ın adıyla başlayan söz, bütün sûreyi ilahî adın altında konumlandırır. Sonraki ayetler bu merhameti soyut bir şefkatten çıkarıp evi, yolculuğu, rızkı ve güvenliği kuşatan fiilî bir bakım olarak gösterir; ad, mevsimsel hareketin üstünde koruyucu bir çatı gibi çalışır.

butuncul_okuma_all_lines.raw_line: **106:1.** لِإِيلَٰفِ قُرَيْشٍ — Birincil okuma: Ayet, Kureyş'in alışkanlık ve ülfet düzenini gerekçe olarak öne çıkarır. Fakat sonraki yolculuk, ev ve güvenlik ayetleri bu ülfeti sadece psikolojik yakınlık değil, dağılabilecek insanları, yolları ve mevsimleri tek bir toplumsal devreye bağlayan kurulmuş bir düzen haline getirir. {ء ل ف B005; ء ل ف B002; ء ل ف B001; ر ح ل B006; ع ب د B010; ر ب ب B004; ب ي ت B008}
butuncul_okuma_all_lines.reading_text_tr: Ayet, Kureyş'in alışkanlık ve ülfet düzenini gerekçe olarak öne çıkarır. Fakat sonraki yolculuk, ev ve güvenlik ayetleri bu ülfeti sadece psikolojik yakınlık değil, dağılabilecek insanları, yolları ve mevsimleri tek bir toplumsal devreye bağlayan kurulmuş bir düzen haline getirir.

butuncul_okuma_all_lines.raw_line: **106:2.** إِۦلَٰفِهِمْ رِحْلَةَ ٱلشِّتَآءِ وَٱلصَّيْفِ — Birincil okuma: Ayet, onların kış ve yaz yolculuğuna alıştırılmış olmasını anlatır. Bütün bağlam bu yolculuğu iki seyahatten ibaret bırakmaz; eyer, binek, konak, geçim, kıtlık, yağmur ve emniyet şartlarıyla ayakta duran korunmuş bir yıllık dolaşım sistemi olarak okutur. {ء ل ف B002; ء ل ف B005; ر ح ل B001; ر ح ل B002; ر ح ل B006; ش ت و B004; ص ي ف B002; ط ع م B004; ء م ن B001}
butuncul_okuma_all_lines.reading_text_tr: Ayet, onların kış ve yaz yolculuğuna alıştırılmış olmasını anlatır. Bütün bağlam bu yolculuğu iki seyahatten ibaret bırakmaz; eyer, binek, konak, geçim, kıtlık, yağmur ve emniyet şartlarıyla ayakta duran korunmuş bir yıllık dolaşım sistemi olarak okutur.

butuncul_okuma_all_lines.raw_line: **106:3.** فَلْيَعْبُدُوا۟ رَبَّ هَٰذَا ٱلْبَيْتِ — Birincil okuma: Önceki nimet düzeni sebebiyle bu evin Rabbine kulluk etmeleri istenir. Son ve önceki ayetler, buradaki Rabbi yalnız hükmeden sahip değil; evi merkez yapan, bağlı topluluğu besleyen, yolları güvenli kılan ve evin şerefini kendisine yönelten bakıcı-sahip olarak belirginleştirir. {ع ب د B003; ع ب د B005; ع ب د B006; ر ب ب B001; ر ب ب B002; ب ي ت B001; ب ي ت B008; خ و ف B001; ء م ن B001}
butuncul_okuma_all_lines.reading_text_tr: Önceki nimet düzeni sebebiyle bu evin Rabbine kulluk etmeleri istenir. Son ve önceki ayetler, buradaki Rabbi yalnız hükmeden sahip değil; evi merkez yapan, bağlı topluluğu besleyen, yolları güvenli kılan ve evin şerefini kendisine yönelten bakıcı-sahip olarak belirginleştirir.

butuncul_okuma_all_lines.raw_line: **106:4.** ٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍۢ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍۭ — Birincil okuma: Ayet, Allah'ın onları açlıktan doyurduğunu ve korkudan güvene çıkardığını bildirir. Önceki ülfet, mevsimsel yolculuk ve ev merkezi bu doyurmayı tek öğün değil geçim düzeni, bu güvenliği de iç huzur değil yol, toplum ve beden üzerinde eksilmeyi durduran güvenli dolaşım olarak değiştirir. {ط ع م B002; ط ع م B004; ج و ع B001; ج و ع B002; ء م ن B001; ء م ن B002; خ و ف B001; خ و ف B004; ر ح ل B007}
butuncul_okuma_all_lines.arabic_text: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍۢ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍۭ
butuncul_okuma_all_lines.reading_text_tr: Ayet, Allah'ın onları açlıktan doyurduğunu ve korkudan güvene çıkardığını bildirir. Önceki ülfet, mevsimsel yolculuk ve ev merkezi bu doyurmayı tek öğün değil geçim düzeni, bu güvenliği de iç huzur değil yol, toplum ve beden üzerinde eksilmeyi durduran güvenli dolaşım olarak değiştirir.

parent_channels.name: Seasonal Mobility and Settlement

subchannels.name: The Accustomed Seasonal Itinerary
subchannels.scene_or_process: A recurring winter-and-summer route becomes familiar to its travelers and part of an established communal rhythm.
subchannels.active_motifs: familiar attachment `ء ل ف:B005/m01`; domesticated familiarity `ء ل ف:B005/m02`; departure and travel `ر ح ل:B001/m01`; winter season `ش ت و:B001/m01`; summer season `ص ي ف:B001/m01`; summer as a deadline of neglect or fulfilled need `ص ي ف:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Repetition turns departure into an accustomed itinerary: people, places, and even domestic creatures can become familiar through continued association. Winter and summer mark the route's alternating phases, while the summer proverb recasts the season as the point when preparation either bears fruit or proves neglected.

subchannels.name: Outfitting and Assisting the Journey
subchannels.scene_or_process: A traveler equips a capable animal, secures its saddle, and receives practical help for departure.
subchannels.active_motifs: camel saddle `ر ح ل:B002/m01`; saddling `ر ح ل:B003/m01`; strong journey mount `ر ح ل:B005/m01`; journey assistance or provision of a mount `ر ح ل:B008/m01`; reliable carrier `ء م ن:B001/m04`
subchannels.synthesis: Mobility depends on a fitted saddle, the act of securing it, a mount able to bear the route, and aid that supplies or sustains that mount. Reliability extends the security root into the animal infrastructure of safe passage.

subchannels.name: Stages, Quarters, and Abiding
subchannels.scene_or_process: Movement alternates with temporary stages, portable lodging, seasonal quarters, approach, and prolonged residence.
subchannels.active_motifs: lodging or home `ر ح ل:B004/m01`; carried household effects `ر ح ل:B004/m02`; stage between departures `ر ح ل:B006/m01`; entering or residing through winter `ش ت و:B002/m01`; winter quarters `ش ت و:B002/m02`; summer residence `ص ي ف:B003/m01`; abiding in place `ر ب ب:B007/m01`; persistence and duration `ر ب ب:B007/m02`; approach to a stopping place `ر ب ب:B007/m03`
subchannels.synthesis: The route is articulated by places where travelers approach, unload, remain, and later depart. Seasonal residence gives movement a durable rhythm, while portable effects allow a temporary station to function as a home.

subchannels.name: Forced and Broken Passage
subchannels.scene_or_process: A journey is disrupted when a person is displaced, burdened, or stranded by a failed or resistant mount.
subchannels.active_motifs: forced removal from place `ر ح ل:B007/m01`; harmful riding or imposed burden `ر ح ل:B009/m01`; mount failure and interrupted travel `ع ب د:B011/m01`; recalcitrant camel `ع ب د:B011/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: The orderly itinerary reverses into involuntary movement or immobilization. Excess burden, an exhausted carrier, or a resisting animal breaks the relation between traveler, mount, and destination.

subchannels.name: Saddle Forms Beyond Riding
subchannels.scene_or_process: The visual outline of travel gear is transferred to textiles and animal coat markings.
subchannels.active_motifs: saddle-patterned cloth `ر ح ل:B010/m01`; saddle-shaped white marking `ر ح ل:B011/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The saddle becomes a recognizable form independent of its transport function. Its silhouette can organize woven ornament or name the contrasting patch on an animal's back where a rider would sit.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Repeated travel becomes an organized cycle through seasonal timing, equipment, staged lodging, attachment to place, and interruption of passage.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 106:1-2 centers إِيلَٰفِ قُرَيْشٍ and إِۦلَٰفِهِمْ رِحْلَةَ ٱلشِّتَآءِ وَٱلصَّيْفِ.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The journey frame extends from customary attachment to domestication, forced removal, failed mounts, and saddle-shaped visual signs.

parent_channels.name: Provision, Scarcity, and Ecological Renewal

subchannels.name: Seasonal Earning and Distribution
subchannels.scene_or_process: Seasonal activity generates livelihood and revenue that can be accumulated gradually and redistributed as food.
subchannels.active_motifs: summer work and provisioning `ص ي ف:B003/m02`; incremental acquisition `ق ر ش:B004/m01`; livelihood and provision `ط ع م:B004/m01`; income-producing estate or revenue `ط ع م:B004/m03`; feeding another `ط ع م:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Productive activity is timed to a season, gathered piece by piece, stabilized as livelihood or revenue, and completed socially when one person feeds another. Acquisition and distribution are consecutive phases of one provisioning process.

subchannels.name: Communal Famine and Relief
subchannels.scene_or_process: Seasonal failure empties stomachs, widens into collective famine, and is answered by available food.
subchannels.active_motifs: food and nourishment `ط ع م:B001/m02`; empty-belly hunger `ج و ع:B001/m01`; communal famine `ج و ع:B002/m01`; imposed hunger `ج و ع:B003/m01`; winter famine `ش ت و:B004/m01`; famine-year gathering `ق ر ش:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Hunger begins as bodily emptiness but can become a public condition in which a harsh year gathers people and livestock around dwindling resources. Feeding reverses that movement from environmental scarcity to bodily deprivation.

subchannels.name: Chosen Hunger and Figurative Emptiness
subchannels.scene_or_process: Hunger is voluntarily induced or projected onto longing, an unfilled vessel, and a slender body.
subchannels.active_motifs: deliberate therapeutic restraint `ج و ع:B003/m02`; hunger as longing for encounter `ج و ع:B004/m01`; empty pot `ج و ع:B004/m02`; slender abdomen `ج و ع:B004/m03`
subchannels.synthesis: The hunger schema can be controlled for treatment, experienced as desire, recognized in an unfilled container, or read from bodily thinness. Absence of intake becomes a shared state across intention, emotion, vessel, and body.

subchannels.name: Rain, Water, Greenery, and Ripening
subchannels.scene_or_process: Seasonal rain gathers into water, sustains enduring vegetation, and brings fruit to flavor and maturity.
subchannels.active_motifs: winter rain `ش ت و:B003/m01`; summer rain `ص ي ف:B002/m01`; summer pasture produced by rain `ص ي ف:B002/m02`; layered raincloud `ر ب ب:B008/m01`; persistent plant-nurturing rain `ر ب ب:B008/m02`; abundant gathered water `ر ب ب:B013/m01`; evergreen plant `ر ب ب:B012/m01`; fruit ripening and bearing `ط ع م:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Clouds accumulate, rain falls in its season, water gathers, vegetation remains green, and fruit acquires edible maturity. The scene links weather to nourishment through a continuous ecological sequence.

subchannels.name: Keeping, Concentrating, and Fattening Food
subchannels.scene_or_process: Food is held overnight, cooled or aged in a vessel, concentrated into a thick extract, and embodied as animal fat.
subchannels.active_motifs: one-night provision `ب ي ت:B005/m01`; overnight-kept liquid `ب ي ت:B006/m01`; thick syrup or residue `ر ب ب:B006/m01`; fattened livestock `ط ع م:B007/m01`; tasting `ط ع م:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Provision is not only acquired but temporally transformed. A night's keeping cools or settles liquids, concentration preserves edible substance, and accumulated nourishment becomes perceptible as flavor and animal fat.

subchannels.name: Hunting Instruments and Procurement
subchannels.scene_or_process: A bow, trained animal, or specialized bodily implement procures game for its owner.
subchannels.active_motifs: game-procuring bow `ط ع م:B006/m01`; trained hunting animal `ط ع م:B006/m02`; game-procuring finger `ط ع م:B006/m03`
subchannels.synthesis: The food root names distinct hunting instruments by their common outcome: each brings game to its owner. Provision is realized through directed capture rather than cultivation or trade.

subchannels.name: Maritime Command and Predation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A prepared vessel crosses waters governed by a shipmaster while a dominant sea creature occupies the same environment.
subchannels.active_motifs: sea predator `ق ر ش:B005/m01`; shipmaster `ر ب ب:B017/m01`; tarred or coated ship `ع ب د:B005/m03`
subchannels.synthesis: Maritime passage combines command, a vessel made serviceable by coating, and a predator that dominates other sea creatures. Human control of the ship is set against animal dominance within the water itself.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Sustenance moves through seasonal work, acquisition, feeding, deprivation, rain-driven growth, preservation, hunting, and predation.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 106:2 names winter and summer, while 106:4 presents أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍ.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Food imagery expands into revenue, deliberate restraint, fertile weather, thickened materials, hunting instruments, and maritime command.

parent_channels.name: Household Formation and Dependent Care

subchannels.name: Dwelling and Final Dwelling
subchannels.scene_or_process: A house shelters the living and, by analogy, the grave houses the dead.
subchannels.active_motifs: dwelling and shelter `ب ي ت:B001/m01`; grave-house `ب ي ت:B007/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The house is defined by shelter and inhabitation. The same spatial relation extends to the grave as the deceased person's final place of residence.

subchannels.name: Marriage, Household, and Stepchild
subchannels.scene_or_process: Marriage establishes a household whose membership can include children received from an earlier union.
subchannels.active_motifs: household members `ب ي ت:B002/m01`; marriage and household formation `ب ي ت:B010/m01`; foster child or stepchild `ر ب ب:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Building a house with a spouse creates a social unit rather than only a structure. The stepchild motif expands that unit through incorporation and care rather than birth alone.

subchannels.name: Guardianship and New Life
subchannels.scene_or_process: A caregiver tends a dependent whose arrival may be late, recent, or marked by maternal residence near the house.
subchannels.active_motifs: caregiver, guardian, or nurse `ر ب ب:B005/m02`; child born in a parent's old age `ص ي ف:B004/m01`; newly birthing ewe kept home for milk `ر ب ب:B009/m01`; freshness and youth `ر ب ب:B009/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Care links human guardianship with animal maternity. Late offspring and recent birth both renew the household, while remaining near home allows the dependent to be fed and protected.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A house gathers inhabitants, forms kin relations, receives dependents, and continues itself through marriage, guardianship, and new life.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The dwelling extends to the grave, while household continuity includes stepchildren, late offspring, and a newly birthing ewe kept near home.

parent_channels.name: Lordship, Service, and Relational Obligation

subchannels.name: Divine Lordship and Worship
subchannels.scene_or_process: Worshippers answer the sovereignty of the Lord with obedient, humbled devotion.
subchannels.active_motifs: divine Lordship `ر ب ب:B001/m01`; worship and submissive obedience `ع ب د:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Lordship supplies the governing role and worship supplies the answering action. The relation is completed when recognized sovereignty becomes enacted obedience.

subchannels.name: Possession, Chattel Status, and Subjugation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A possessor claims authority over another person and can reduce that person to owned or compelled service.
subchannels.active_motifs: owner or master `ر ب ب:B001/m02`; possession relation `ذ و و:B001/m01`; chattel slavery `ع ب د:B001/m01`; enslaving or subjugating `ع ب د:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Grammatical possession becomes a social relation when a master claims a dependent as property. The servitude root distinguishes the resulting status from the action that imposes it.

subchannels.name: Nurture, Completion, and Learned Guidance
subchannels.scene_or_process: A responsible authority raises a dependent gradually and cultivates knowledge through a learned guide.
subchannels.active_motifs: progressive raising and nurture `ر ب ب:B002/m02`; learned scholar or sage `ر ب ب:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Authority can operate through formation rather than coercion. The caregiver brings a dependent toward completion, while the learned figure cultivates understanding and disciplined relation to the Lord.

subchannels.name: Covenant, Trust, and Faith
subchannels.scene_or_process: Parties enter protection through a pledge, entrust valued things, and answer reliable word with assent or faith.
subchannels.active_motifs: covenant and pledged protection `ر ب ب:B011/m01`; entrusted deposit and trust `ء م ن:B001/m03`; assent to a report or promise `ء م ن:B002/m01`; religious faith `ء م ن:B002/m02`; favor or beneficence `ر ب ب:B016/m03`
subchannels.synthesis: Covenant creates an obligation to protect, trust places something under another's care, and assent receives a word as reliable. Favor supplies the benevolent outcome of a relation governed by fidelity rather than force.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Authority binds lord and worshipper, owner and dependent, teacher and learner, covenant partners, and entrusted parties.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 106:3 commands فَلْيَعْبُدُوا۟ رَبَّ, and 106:4 adds the security relation in ءَامَنَهُم.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The authority frame ranges from divine worship to chattel domination, progressive nurture, learned guidance, trusted deposits, and pledged protection.

parent_channels.name: Security, Fear, and Loss

subchannels.name: Granted Safety Against Apprehension
subchannels.scene_or_process: An exposed community receives safety and safe conduct that quiet anticipated harm.
subchannels.active_motifs: secure calm `ء م ن:B001/m01`; granting safe conduct `ء م ن:B001/m02`; apprehensive fear `خ و ف:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Fear projects a coming injury from its signs, while security removes that expectation and establishes protected movement or residence. Granting safety turns an inner state into a social guarantee.

subchannels.name: Producing, Displaying, and Contesting Fear
subchannels.scene_or_process: One party induces fear, the affected person visibly manifests it, and rivals struggle over who dominates or fears more.
subchannels.active_motifs: intimidation or caution through fear `خ و ف:B002/m01`; contest and dominance in fear `خ و ف:B003/m01`; visible fear `خ و ف:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Fear becomes an interaction rather than a private emotion. It can be deliberately produced as warning or coercion, read from the body, and used to rank opponents within a contest of dominance.

subchannels.name: Diminution and the Aftermath of Loss
subchannels.scene_or_process: Something is progressively taken away until its absence produces grief, regret, or wounded attachment.
subchannels.active_motifs: gradual diminution `خ و ف:B004/m01`; grief and regret after loss `ع ب د:B008/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Threat is recast as attrition: the feared object is not struck once but reduced over time. The emotional aftermath appears as sorrow or regret when the diminished good is finally lost.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Security is defined against anticipated harm, manufactured fear, visible alarm, competitive intimidation, and the erosion that leaves grief behind.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 106:4 places ءَامَنَهُم in explicit opposition to خَوْفٍ.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Fear moves from an inward expectation to a displayed state, a tactic of domination, and a process of gradual diminution.

parent_channels.name: Assembly, Quantity, and Dispersion

subchannels.name: Joining and Dispersing Parts
subchannels.scene_or_process: Separate elements are drawn together into an integrated whole, while groups or routes can reverse that motion and scatter.
subchannels.active_motifs: joining after separation `ء ل ف:B002/m01`; gathering from different directions `ق ر ش:B001/m01`; groups or roads dispersing in every direction `ع ب د:B010/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Gathering and joining converge on centripetal movement from plurality toward a whole. Dispersion supplies the structural reversal, sending a previously coherent set outward along divergent paths.

subchannels.name: Thousands, Multitudes, and Gathered Sets
subchannels.scene_or_process: Quantity becomes visible as a thousand, a massed community, a set of arrows, or a herd.
subchannels.active_motifs: thousand-count `ء ل ف:B001/m01`; multitudes and allied groups `ر ب ب:B004/m01`; gathered gambling arrows `ر ب ب:B010/m02`; animal herd `ر ب ب:B014/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Abstract number receives concrete collective forms. Human groups, bundled arrows, and herds each turn multiplicity into a bounded set that can be counted, moved, or acted upon as one.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Separate elements can be joined into wholes, counted at scale, gathered as living or functional sets, or scattered again in multiple directions.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 106:1-2 anchors the channel in إِيلَٰفِ and قُرَيْشٍ, while 106:3 contributes the collective senses of رَبَّ and فَلْيَعْبُدُوا۟.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Joining reaches from composition and communal gathering to thousands, allied masses, gambling arrows, herds, and dispersing roads.

parent_channels.name: Language, Reference, and Responsive Exchange

subchannels.name: Letters and the Composed Line
subchannels.scene_or_process: Individual letters and ordered verbal parts are assembled into a bounded metrical line.
subchannels.active_motifs: letter alif `ء ل ف:B006/m01`; ordered composition of diverse parts `ء ل ف:B002/m02`; poetic line `ب ي ت:B003/m01`; letter ha `ه ا ء:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The alphabet supplies discrete signs, composition orders them, and the poetic house gathers words, sounds, and meanings under meter. The spatial image of a house thus becomes a textual unit.

subchannels.name: Deixis, Relation, and Inquiry
subchannels.scene_or_process: A speaker directs attention, points to an entity, links a relative clause, or asks what is meant.
subchannels.active_motifs: relative linker `ذ و و:B002/m01`; demonstrative pointing `ذ و و:B003/m01`; interrogative "what" `ذ و و:B004/m01`; relative "what/that which" `ذ و و:B004/m02`; attention opener `ه ا ء:B002/m01`; interrogative substitute `ه ا ء:B004/m01`; grammatical particle `ر ب ب:B015/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Attention and pointing establish a referent; relative forms attach further description; interrogation opens a slot for an unknown referent. The particles organize how speaker, listener, and mentioned entity are related in discourse.

subchannels.name: Prayer, Answer, and Handoff
subchannels.scene_or_process: A call or prayer receives a spoken answer, while an imperative accompanies the physical act of giving something to another.
subchannels.active_motifs: "Amen" as a request for response `ء م ن:B003/m01`; answer or call-response `ه ا ء:B003/m01`; offer and "take" imperative `ه ا ء:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Prayer projects a desired answer, the response particle voices availability to a caller, and the handoff formula joins speech to transfer. In each case an utterance completes an exchange initiated by another party.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Letters and composed lines become speech through reference, questioning, attention, response, prayer, and handoff.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 106:1-2 supplies the ألف root, 106:3 contains هَٰذَا and بَيْتِ, and 106:4 contains ٱلَّذِىٓ and the أمن root.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Lexical imagery moves from alphabetic signs and metrical composition to deixis, relative linkage, ritual response, and an imperative of transfer.

parent_channels.name: Material Integration, Repair, and Breach

subchannels.name: Grafting, Knotting, and Successive Formation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A new element is accepted into a living stock, a knot holds joined parts, and form develops through successive continuity.
subchannels.active_motifs: accepted graft `ط ع م:B010/m01`; secure knot `ر ب ب:B016/m02`; successive formation `ط ع م:B014/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Integration can be organic, mechanical, or developmental. The graft survives because the host accepts the join, the knot preserves tension between parts, and successive formation extends continuity through time.

subchannels.name: Repairing, Smoothing, and Coating
subchannels.scene_or_process: A material is completed or made serviceable by repair, smoothing, paving, or treatment with a concentrated substance.
subchannels.active_motifs: repair and completion `ر ب ب:B002/m01`; treating material with thick residue `ر ب ب:B006/m02`; paved or smoothed road `ع ب د:B005/m01`; tar-coated animal `ع ب د:B005/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Repair restores a whole, coating protects or conditions a surface, and paving turns rough ground into a usable route. Each operation converts resistant material into a stable functional form.

subchannels.name: Specialized Receptacles
subchannels.scene_or_process: A container is shaped around the substance or instrument it must carry, hold, or heat.
subchannels.active_motifs: leather honey-gathering bag `خ و ف:B006/m01`; water-carrier's leather bag or garment `خ و ف:B006/m02`; leather arrow case `ر ب ب:B010/m01`; perfume brazier `ع ب د:B012/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Honey or water, arrows, and perfume each demand a specialized receptacle. The container's material and shape are determined by whether its contents must be transported, bundled, or heated.

subchannels.name: Collision, Fracture, and Forced Entry
subchannels.scene_or_process: Contact escalates from interlocking weapons to bodily compression, bone fracture, or a foreign particle entering the eye.
subchannels.active_motifs: interlocking spears `ق ر ش:B006/m01`; bone-cracking wound `ق ر ش:B008/m01`; throat grip and choking `ط ع م:B012/m01`; eye admitting a speck `ط ع م:B010/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: These motifs share a boundary under pressure. Spears occupy the same space, a grip compresses the throat, a blow breaches bone without crushing it, and a speck crosses the eye's surface.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Materials and parts acquire form through joining, knotting, layering, coating, containment, collision, or forced entry.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; the participating roots occur in 106:1-4 through إِيلَٰفِ, رَبَّ, بَيْتِ, فَلْيَعْبُدُوا۟, أَطْعَمَهُم, خَوْفٍ, and قُرَيْشٍ.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The same structural field includes grafted branches, paved roads, leather containers, perfume equipment, interlocked spears, cracked bone, and an eye admitting a speck.

parent_channels.name: Capacity, Judgment, and Controlled Motion

subchannels.name: Need, Ability, and Durable Readiness
subchannels.scene_or_process: A need is met by sufficient ability, bodily stoutness, and material durability.
subchannels.active_motifs: need `ر ب ب:B016/m01`; ability `ط ع م:B011/m01`; bodily strength or stoutness `ع ب د:B007/m01`; durable cloth or material `ع ب د:B007/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Need defines the task, capacity makes action possible, bodily strength sustains exertion, and durable material withstands repeated use. Readiness appears as resistance to failure across person, animal, and object.

subchannels.name: Reason, Value, and Receptivity to Reform
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person is evaluated by judgment, effective vitality or worth, and the ability to receive correction.
subchannels.active_motifs: reason and practical judgment `ط ع م:B008/m01`; value or vitality `ط ع م:B008/m02`; receptivity to discipline and reform `ط ع م:B008/m03`
subchannels.synthesis: Capacity is cognitive and ethical as well as physical. Sound judgment directs conduct, vitality gives action weight, and receptivity allows instruction to alter future behavior.

subchannels.name: Equine Cue and Acceleration
subchannels.scene_or_process: Contact at the horse's mouth becomes a cue for rapid forward motion with minimal delay.
subchannels.active_motifs: horse muzzle or lips `ط ع م:B009/m01`; urging a horse to run `ط ع م:B009/m02`; little delay `ع ب د:B009/m01`; swift running `ع ب د:B009/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: The anatomical control point at the mouth is linked to the request for speed. A responsive animal converts the cue into acceleration, joining bodily interface, command, and rapid outcome.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Effective action depends on durable strength, available capacity, sound judgment, responsiveness to correction, and bodily control of motion.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 106:2 contributes the travel setting, 106:3 the service root, and 106:4 the security and food roots.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The food root extends from physical ability to reason, value, teachability, the horse's mouth, and the cue that releases speed.

parent_channels.name: Honor, Intrusion, and Communal Boundaries

subchannels.name: Named Lineage and Honored Status
subchannels.scene_or_process: A named community locates status in ancestry, a noble house, inherited titles, and public honor.
subchannels.active_motifs: Quraysh as tribe and lineage name `ق ر ش:B002/m01`; noble house and ancestry `ب ي ت:B008/m01`; titular attribution `ذ و و:B001/m02`; honored or revered person `ع ب د:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Tribal naming identifies communal descent, the noble house concentrates that descent into a status-bearing lineage, and titles make rank linguistically visible. Honor is completed when others treat the ranked person as one to be served or revered.

subchannels.name: Hospitality, Request, and the Interloper
subchannels.scene_or_process: A host's provision attracts a requester whose participation may cross the boundary into uninvited consumption.
subchannels.active_motifs: generous hospitality `ط ع م:B004/m02`; requesting food `ط ع م:B002/m02`; freeloader or interloper `ق ر ش:B009/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Feeding establishes host and recipient roles. A request can be answered within that frame, while the interloper enters without recognized standing and exposes the social boundary around shared provision.

subchannels.name: Denunciation, Insult, and Indignation
subchannels.scene_or_process: Speech attacks standing by informing against someone, stirring conflict, or casting an insulting lineage formula, provoking proud anger.
subchannels.active_motifs: denunciation and tale-bearing `ق ر ش:B007/m01`; agitation between parties `ق ر ش:B007/m02`; saddle-based insult `ر ح ل:B012/m01`; proud indignation `ع ب د:B008/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Reputation is damaged indirectly through speech that exposes, incites, or degrades ancestry. Indignation is the answering emotion when a person's standing or affiliation is publicly attacked.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Communities define belonging through ancestry, titled status, hospitality, exclusion, reputation, accusation, and insult.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 106:1 names قُرَيْشٍ, 106:2 names the journey, 106:3 the house and service relation, and 106:4 the act of feeding.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: A named lineage opens into noble houses, honorifics, honored service, the uninvited eater, denunciation, and a saddle-based insult.

parent_channels.name: S1. Mouth-to-Mouth Reciprocity
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Two mouths meet in a reciprocal contact associated with kissing or the behavior of birds.
parent_channels.synthesis: The food root moves from taking nourishment into the mouth to direct exchange between mouths. The scene preserves reciprocity and intimate contact without reducing it to ordinary eating.

parent_channels.name: S2. Rough Terrain and Deflected Courses
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A traveler or moving object encounters rough ground, misses its intended line, or follows a crooked watercourse.
parent_channels.active_motifs: rough place or head of a wadi `ش ت و:B005/m01`; deviation from an aim `ص ي ف:B005/m01`; crooked watercourse `ص ي ف:B005/m02`
parent_channels.synthesis: Terrain and trajectory meet in the problem of a course that does not remain straight. Rough ground can redirect movement, just as an arrow veers from its target or water bends through an irregular channel.

parent_channels.name: S3. Night Residence and Concealed Action
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Night provides both a period of staying and cover for secret planning or attack.
parent_channels.active_motifs: night residence or activity `ب ي ت:B004/m01`; covert night planning or assault `ب ي ت:B004/m02`
parent_channels.synthesis: The house root marks what is done or endured overnight, then sharpens that temporal setting into clandestine deliberation and hostile arrival under darkness.
